title: fix(cli,service-storage): the Console CSP's connect-src names the store the server presigns uploads to
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XE7Tix5uExkLdxanf8sDFR5)_

Fixes #26200

## Summary

Since the Console document got its nonce CSP, `connect-src` names only `'self'`, the default map style host, the deployment's map style and error-reporting origins, and `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC`. With S3 or an S3-compatible store, the Console uploads a file by `PUT`ting it straight to the presigned URL, on the store's host. That host was not in the policy, so the browser refused every upload with `TypeError: Failed to fetch`.

The ruling on the card (「另在 objectstack 立卡让 CSP 自动带上存储端点」) asks for the configured store's origin exactly as the presigner emits it, with one copy of the endpoint rule and no wildcard. This PR does that in two parts.

- **`@objectstack/service-storage`.** `S3StorageAdapter.getPresignedUploadOrigin()` signs a probe `PutObject` for the adapter's own bucket with the same client options every real presign uses (factored into one private `clientOptions()`), and answers the URL's origin. The presigner decides the host, so a virtual-hosted bucket, a region-templated AWS host, a path-style endpoint and a bucket name that cannot be a host label all come out as the upload URL carries them. The probe signs with fixed fake credentials, so it never consults the AWS credential chain and never opens a socket. The answer is cached per adapter instance, and a rejection is not cached. `SwappableStorageService.getPresignedUploadOrigin()` answers the active adapter's origin, or `undefined` when that adapter has none (the local adapter's uploads go to the server itself).
- **`@objectstack/cli` (`utils/console.ts`).** The mount reads `getPresignedUploadOrigin` off the kernel's `storage` service by name, per document, and adds the answer to `connect-src` after the error-reporting origin and before `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC`. The module still imports Node built-ins only. An answer that does not match the module's existing connect-source grammar (an IPv6 literal, say) is left out, and so is a failure to answer (an endpoint the SDK refuses); either is reported once at `warn`, naming `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC` as the remedy. No storage service, or the local adapter, adds nothing.

**Runtime settings.** Storage can be changed in Setup → Settings without a restart: `StorageServicePlugin` swaps the adapter inside the one `SwappableStorageService`. Because the mount reads the origin per document, not at boot, the next document after a swap names the new store (pinned below).

**Hosted.** cloud's `objectos-runtime` mounts the Console through `createConsoleStaticPlugin`, whose signature is unchanged. The origin arrives through the kernel's `storage` service, so no call-site change is needed wherever that kernel registers `StorageServicePlugin`. Whether `objectos-runtime`'s kernel does is outside this repository and not measured here (see Acceptance notes).

## Tests

- `packages/cli/src/utils/console.content-security-policy.test.ts`, new describe `connect-src names the host the storage service presigns browser uploads to`. Each case runs the REAL `StorageServicePlugin.init` and the REAL console plugin on a REAL Hono app:
  - an R2-style store (virtual-hosted) adds `https://csp-uploads.acct123.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`, the bucket host and not the endpoint host;
  - parity: for an R2 endpoint, AWS `eu-west-2`, AWS with a dotted bucket, and a path-style `http://127.0.0.1:9000`, the served `connect-src` equals `'self'`, the map host and the origin of a real `getPresignedUpload` URL from the same service;
  - a settings swap (`storage.swap(...)`) is followed on the next document;
  - local storage adds nothing;
  - an endpoint the presigner refuses adds nothing and warns once over two documents;
  - `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC` still follows the storage origin.
- `packages/services/service-storage/src/s3-storage-adapter.presign-origin.test.ts`: five configurations (virtual-hosted and path-style S3-compatible endpoints, a self-hosted port, AWS region-templated, AWS dotted bucket), each answering the origin of a real presigned upload URL and the literal expected origin; no credentials needed; two refused endpoints reject; the swappable service follows a swap and answers `undefined` for the local adapter.

**Red first** (base `3d50a43bc`, the CLI suite before the fix): 4 failed / 40 passed. Each storage case read `connect-src 'self' https://demotiles.maplibre.org` and nothing else.

**Ablation** (at head `0fd3cd0d`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; the suite imports `console.ts` from source, so there is no dist leg): deleting the line that pushes `storageUploadOrigin` into `connect-src` landed (anchor 1 → 0, blob `497ea91966dc` → `1f54438adfbc`), the CSP suite went 4 failed / 41 passed, and the restore matched `HEAD` with `git diff HEAD` empty.

Package runs, at head `8990880046` (after merging `origin/main`, which touched `service-storage`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test`: 67 files, 1236 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage typecheck` and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck`: exit 0.
- `vitest run --project unit` for the CSP suite and `test/published-subpath-console.pin.test.ts` (the packed `@objectstack/cli/console` still resolves with Node built-ins only): 2 files, 59 tests passed.
- Before that merge (head `0fd3cd0d`): the whole CLI `unit` project, 334 files, 4884 tests passed. The `integration` tier is declared to CI; the diff touches no spawn entry.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over the six touched files: exit 0.

## Gates

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 72 commands at head `0fd3cd0d`. Each ran with its exit code captured by redirect before any pipe. Three first exited 3 on a prerequisite this worktree lacked (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` on a shallow clone, and `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:i18n-coverage` on unbuilt packages outside the diff). They were rerun after unshallowing and building, and exited 0.
- `--ran` reconciliation: "72 derived, 72 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN", exit 0.
- After merging `origin/main` (head `8990880046`) the derivation is the same list less the two `check-position-name-fold-loaders` rows that main retired. The ratchet families (`check:type-check-coverage`, `check:type-check-debt`, `check:query-options-erasure`, `check:test-source-alias`, `check:cross-package-test-inputs`) and `check:nul-bytes` were rerun there, and all exited 0. At the final head `1f201e46b4`, which changes only the changeset's wording, the changeset gates (`check-changeset-no-major`, `check-adr-0087-registration`, `check-empty-changeset`) and `check:nul-bytes` exited 0.
- Dogfood battery: not run. The title has no `!` and `Clause-②` has no `(narrowing)` arm.

## Declarations

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

Measured on the diff. Two new public methods ship on exported classes of a published package (`S3StorageAdapter#getPresignedUploadOrigin`, `SwappableStorageService#getPresignedUploadOrigin`), and the Console policy accepts one more origin. That origin is always the one the server itself hands the page. No metadata an author writes moves, so both packages take a `patch` changeset (`.changeset/26200-console-csp-storage-upload-origin.md`). Nothing is removed or narrowed, so ADR-0087 has no disposition to state. `packages/spec` is untouched, as the claim requires.

## Acceptance notes

- **The hosted half is a verification, not a change.** `createConsoleStaticPlugin` reads `storage` off the kernel context it is started in. If cloud's `objectos-runtime` registers `StorageServicePlugin` on that kernel, hosted uploads work once the framework pin moves past this PR, and the `OS_CONSOLE_CSP_CONNECT_SRC` stop-gap can be dropped. If it composes storage elsewhere (another kernel, or `mountStorageRoutes` over a service the Console's kernel never sees), the CSP adds nothing there. That cannot be measured from this repository, so it is reported to the seat for a cloud-lane card.
- **What "endpoint unset" was read as.** AWS S3 with no custom endpoint still adds its region-templated origin (`https://BUCKET.s3.REGION.amazonaws.com`). The ruling names region-templated hosts, and those exist only when no endpoint is set. "Unset" was read as "no S3 store configured", which adds nothing. The other reading would leave every AWS-native deployment's uploads blocked.
- **The accessor is not on the `IStorageService` contract.** The claim forbids `packages/spec/**`, so the Console reads the method by name. An adapter from outside this repository that presigns to another host is not covered until it implements the same method, or the contract declares it.
- **The local adapter's `baseUrl` option** could make its presigned URLs absolute on another origin. No producer in this repository sets it, and the ruling says local adds nothing, so the CSP adds nothing for it.
